value.rationale: A single bridge connecting two maximally connected communities is a canonical bottleneck graph for deterministic excitable media. The exact first-entry distribution for all a,b>=2 and sharply bounded transient distinguishes six times of approach, not merely eventual activity; the paired nonrecurrent three-cycle shell counts have a non-obvious 1–6,2–5,3–4 mirror symmetry. The bridge-supported recurrent modes contribute A+B primitive three-cycles absent in the disconnected full-rainbow-only mechanism. Such invariant counts are natural quantitative descriptors of wave persistence and transients, not arbitrary small finite data or a routine direct application of the established cycle criterion.
